glosses: Spanish (of or relating to Spain, its people or culture)
Spanish (of or relating to the Spanish language)

examples.text: Ele é capaz de ensinar espanhol.
examples.en: He is capable of teaching Spanish.

examples.text: Eu sei que ela é espanhola.
examples.en: I know that she is Spanish.

examples.text: Eles sabem falar espanhol um pouco.
examples.en: They are able to speak Spanish a little.
